The oblique rule pins the head to the preposition actually used: 'in stays In; During renders only the word during', so 'in the first hour' is (In sk_down_1 sk_hour_1).

Same rule, and 'of' is not even a nesting word - the entity-attached surface-preposition oblique (Of sk_hour_1 sk_trading_1) is the licensed record, on the same open licence as (From sk_wool_1 calderwick) and (Of sk_refinement_1 sk_survey_1).
